info.title: Posthaste Events
info.description: Event contract for the Posthaste Server-Sent Events stream at `GET /v1/events`. This is the event-driven analogue of the committed `openapi.json` REST contract: it documents the channel, its query filters, the SSE framing, and the full set of event topics. The `topic` enum is drift-checked against `posthaste_domain::ALL_EVENT_TOPICS`.

local.description: Posthaste server; SSE endpoints are served under the `/v1` prefix.

events.description: Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream opened with `GET /v1/events` (`text/event-stream`). Each SSE message uses the default `message` event type (no custom SSE `event:` field): the message `id` is set to the event's `seq`, and `data` is the JSON-serialized `DomainEvent`. When `afterSeq` is supplied, the backend first replays matching backlog from the `event_log` table, then switches to the live broadcast stream so a reconnecting client misses nothing.

accountId.description: Optional. Filter the stream to a single account id.

topic.description: Optional. Filter the stream to a single event topic (one of the `EventTopic` values).

mailboxId.description: Optional. Filter the stream to events for a single mailbox id.

afterSeq.description: Optional. Resume from this sequence number (exclusive): backlog with `seq` greater than this value is replayed before live events begin.

receiveEvents.summary: Receive the live (and optionally backlogged) stream of domain events.

DomainEvent.name: DomainEvent
DomainEvent.title: Domain event
DomainEvent.summary: An ordered domain event delivered as a single SSE message. The SSE `id` field carries `seq`; the SSE `data` field carries the JSON below.

examples.name: syncCompleted
examples.summary: A sync cycle finished for an account.

EventTopic.description: Every event topic the server can emit on `/v1/events`. The concrete shape of `DomainEvent.payload` is topic-dependent and intentionally documented as a free-form object rather than exhaustively typed per topic. This enum is the single documented source the contract drift test compares against `posthaste_domain::ALL_EVENT_TOPICS`.
